hyp.align(w[:2], align='hyper') emitted 'DeprecationWarning: align= is deprecated as a model-spec kwarg name on hypertools.align.align.align; use model= instead (e.g. hyp.align(data, model=\'hyper\')).' and examples/plot_align.py line 22 uses exactly that deprecated form (data = hyp.align(data, align='hyper')).

hyp.cluster(mushrooms, cluster={'model':'HDBSCAN','params':{...}}) emitted "DeprecationWarning: {'model': ..., 'params': {...}} is deprecated; use {'model': ..., 'args': [...], 'kwargs': {...}} instead". Sources confirm the deprecated spec: examples/plot_clusters3.py lines 24-26 use 'params' (and prose says 'the dictionary form which includes both the model and the params'); examples/plot_apply_model.py lines 31-32 use {'model':'PCA','params':...} and {'model':'TSNE','params':...}.

Align datasets with matching numbers of observations to avoid dropping data.' -- the demo aligns a 200-row train set with an 80-row test set and silently loses 120 train rows, with no prose acknowledging it.

Two identical hyp.cluster(data, cluster='GaussianMixture', n_clusters=3) calls: 'same argmax: False; p1 head: [1 1 1 1 1] p2 head: [2 2 2 2 2]'. hyp.reduce(data, reduce='TSNE', ndims=50) on a (30,5) array returned 'shape: (30, 5) passthrough: True' with zero warnings captured under warnings.simplefilter('always') -- the explicitly requested TSNE embedding is silently skipped.

hyp.plot(np.random.rand(30,5), normalize='bogus', show=False) raised exactly "AssertionError: scale_type must be across, within, row, none, or a fitted Normalizer." -- an assertion naming the internal 'scale_type' parameter rather than a ValueError naming the user-facing normalize= kwarg.

hyp.reduce(data, reduce={'model':'Autoencoder','kwargs':{'epochs':-5}}, ndims=2) returned 'shape: (30, 2) finite: True' with no error and no warnings captured -- an invalid negative epochs count is silently accepted, yielding an untrained embedding.
